messages:
Priya: quick async — finished a perf sweep on kernel v2.4.1, saw a tail-latency microburst at ~512 tokens. posting short notes below (WIP). :eyes:

Marta: thx. can you share p95/p99 and whether batching was enabled?

Priya: p95 ~47ms, p99 ~210ms on the r5-prod pool. batching = continuous with target=32, slot_timeout=8ms. suspect KV evict spikes around the same timestamp. link to traces: https://traces.internal/redwood/abc123 (snippet attached).

Alex: are these runs with kv.prefetch enabled? or the old sync path?

Priya: prefetch=on (lrucache warm path), but we saw `kv.eviction.count` blips. log excerpt:```
[2026-03-10 13:02:11] kv.eviction.count=420
[2026-03-10 13:02:11] kernel.slot.stall_ms=120
[2026-03-10 13:02:11] batch.size=28
```

Junaid: that eviction count lines up with the canary I ran last week. likely a rental of hot slots causing spill. any OOMs?

Priya: no OOMs, just stalls. repro steps attached (small script) — will try a short run with batch_target=16 and slot_timeout=16ms to see if tail tightens.

Sam: quick mitigation suggestion: lower batch target or increase slot timeout, + enable adaptive-cache TTL so hot keys stick. both quick toggles in config.

Priya: will run both in a canary. blocker: need a monitored canary window at ~14:30 PT and someone to own rollback if latency worsens. can someone watch?

Marta: :raised_hand: I can watch the canary and rollback. pinging infra-bot to provision extra slot headroom for the window.

infra-bot: Canary window requested by Marta for 2026-03-10 14:30 PT. extra slot headroom +20% requested, ETA 2m.

DevOpsBot: Reminder: if p99 > 200ms for >3 consecutive minutes during canary, trigger auto-rollback. See runbook: https://runbooks.internal/canary-rollback

Priya: awesome, thanks. I'll post quick results once the short run completes. also small FYI — PR #432 has a flaky unit in `kernel/slot_manager` that I need to fix before the full rollout. pinging @Alex for CR after I push the test fix.

Alex: on it, will take a look after lunch. good luck with the canary :thumbsup:

Priya: thanks everyone — will update in this thread with numbers and any follow-ups.
